description:
Convert a messy data file into clean, typed, zstd-compressed Parquet.

Use this first for any CSV/TSV, JSON/NDJSON, Excel, SPSS, Stata or SAS file, or a digital PDF with tables. It detects the format, encoding and delimiter; skips title rows; repairs broken JSON; pulls tables out of PDFs (merging tables that continue across pages); infers int/float/bool/date/timestamp columns (including 1.234,56 and $1,234 formats) while keeping IDs with leading zeros as text; normalizes column names to snake_case; keeps SPSS/Stata/SAS variable and value labels; and can validate against an expected_schema.

Returns an artifact_id (pass it to inspect_parquet / preview_parquet / query_parquet), a download link, and a per-column report: type, null count, values that did not fit the chosen type, and warnings. Price: $0.02 USDC per successful call, paid via x402.

ConvertOptions.description: How to read the input and shape the Parquet output. Every field is optional.

date_order.description: Order for ambiguous dates like 03/04/2025. auto assumes day-first.

encoding.description: Text encoding as a Python codec name, e.g. 'latin-1', 'cp1252' or 'utf-16-le'. Omit to auto-detect.
encoding.title: Encoding

expected_schema.description: Validate and cast to this schema. Unknown columns are kept unless strict.
expected_schema.title: Expected Schema

flatten_nested.description: Flatten nested JSON objects into parent__child columns; lists become JSON.
flatten_nested.title: Flatten Nested

format.description: Force the input format. Omit to auto-detect.

header.description: Whether the first row is a header. Omit to auto-detect.
header.title: Header

infer_types.description: Infer int/float/bool/date/timestamp columns from text. False keeps text.
infer_types.title: Infer Types

json_records_path.description: Dot path to the array of records inside a JSON document, e.g. 'data.items'.
json_records_path.title: Json Records Path

normalize_column_names.description: Rewrite column names to unique snake_case.
normalize_column_names.title: Normalize Column Names

null_values.description: Extra tokens to treat as null, in addition to '', NA, N/A, null, None, -.
null_values.title: Null Values

pdf_pages.description: PDF only: pages to read, e.g. '1-3,7'. Default: all (up to 300).
pdf_pages.title: Pdf Pages

pdf_table.description: PDF only: which detected table to convert (see available_sheets). Default: the largest.
pdf_table.title: Pdf Table

sheet.description: Excel/ODS sheet name or 0-based index. Default: first non-empty sheet.
sheet.title: Sheet

sort_by.description: Sort rows by these columns so Parquet min/max stats prune well.
sort_by.title: Sort By

strict.description: With expected_schema: fail on any value that does not fit, or extra columns.
strict.title: Strict

value_labels.description: SPSS/Stata/SAS value labels: 'metadata' keeps codes and stores labels in Parquet metadata; 'apply' replaces codes with label text; 'both' adds <col>_label columns.

ConvertOptions.title: ConvertOptions

name.description: Column name after normalization (snake_case by default).
name.title: Name

scale.description: decimal only: digits after the point, at most precision. Default 2; 0 for whole numbers. A value that would round to fit is a counted reject, never rounded.
scale.title: Scale

artifact_id.description: artifact_id returned by an earlier convert_to_parquet call: converts that stored Parquet file again, with these options (an expected_schema, say).
artifact_id.title: Artifact Id

content_base64.description: The file's raw bytes, base64-encoded (standard or URL-safe alphabet, '=' padding optional). Small files only (under ~3 MB).
content_base64.title: Content Base64

filename.description: Original filename, e.g. 'survey.sav'. The extension helps format detection.
filename.title: Filename

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the input file. Preferred for anything over ~3 MB.
url.title: Url

name: convert_to_parquet

download_url.description: Signed HTTPS link to the Parquet file, valid until expiry.
download_url.title: Download Url

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time after which the artifact and its download link are unreachable (deletion follows; see data_retention in /pricing).
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Pass as artifact_id to inspect/preview/query without re-upload.
id.title: Id

provenance.description: Post-quantum signature proving this file came unaltered from this service.

inferred_from_text.description: True when the type was inferred from text values.
inferred_from_text.title: Inferred From Text

rejected_count.description: Values that did not fit the chosen type and were set to null.
rejected_count.title: Rejected Count

type.description: Arrow type of the column in the output file.
type.title: Type

estimated_tokens_raw.description: Rough LLM tokens to read the input as text (bytes / 4).
estimated_tokens_raw.title: Estimated Tokens Raw

estimated_tokens_schema.description: Rough LLM tokens for a name/type/null-count digest of the output schema (bytes / 4). The full report you are reading is larger.
estimated_tokens_schema.title: Estimated Tokens Schema

manifest.description: Signed facts: sha256, size, operation, time, service version.
manifest.title: Manifest

public_key_url.description: Where to fetch the verification key.
public_key_url.title: Public Key Url

signature.description: Base64 signature over the canonical JSON of the manifest.
signature.title: Signature

hint.description: Pointer to premium features (local mode only).
hint.title: Hint

title: Convert to Parquet
